study: Official FlashSAC cable gripper-only gain 3 control
scope: One fresh seed 2 gripper-only gain 3 control and the separately audited gain 1 n3/LR96000 pilot; no pooled population, causal mechanism or reliable rescue established.

replay_export.policy: full final replay plus learner state

sampling: Every audited training iteration and scored checkpoint; no smoothing or synthetic missing values.

figures.name: evaluation-transitions
figures.caption: Nine actual saved checkpoints per run on the same 128 complete initial states. Ever-goal, full-budget occupancy, final 15-step hold and lift are distinct. Final distance includes zero and the 5 cm per-state tolerance; that reference is not a population-mean success gate. No contact/grasp condition or confidence interval is inferred. Write-finished time is policy availability, not durability; the separate fresh runs have different process/cache histories.

figures.name: evaluation-wall
figures.caption: Nine actual saved checkpoints per run on the same 128 complete initial states. Ever-goal, full-budget occupancy, final 15-step hold and lift are distinct. Final distance includes zero and the 5 cm per-state tolerance; that reference is not a population-mean success gate. No contact/grasp condition or confidence interval is inferred. Write-finished time is policy availability, not durability; the separate fresh runs have different process/cache histories.

figures.name: stochastic-collection
figures.caption: All 2000 exact per-iteration aggregates from each run, including uniform warmup and autoresets; no smoothing. World-ever is not episode success. Goal distance and height include zero and 5 cm references. Finger positions reconstruct relative observations plus defaults; their 0–8 cm sum is not a measured fingertip gap or contact geometry. The last panel separates mean scaled task command (left axis) from positive-command fraction (right axis). Policy coordinates remain normalized; per-step height gain is in summary.json. These proxies do not prove grasp.

figures.name: optimization-diagnostics
figures.caption: Keys can come from different update calls; these are not iteration means. Alpha weights entropy loss rather than multiplying rollout noise; negative differential entropy is valid. The Gaussian-reference target is not a measured action standard deviation. Critic loss and max_entropy_bonus do not prove support saturation or a causal failure mechanism.

figures.name: action-reward-diagnostics
figures.caption: Every exact iteration is retained. These are normalized policy/replay coordinates: dimensions0–6 retain gain 1; dimension 7 has gain 1 in the reference and gain 3 in the control before the unchanged stock gripper mapping. RMS is not stochastic standard deviation or actuator saturation. Weighted reward contributions include control_dt and precede SAC normalization; shaping rewards alone do not establish physical lift or goal attainment.

figures.name: execution-costs
figures.caption: Two individually observed protocols; no average or speed ratio. Gain1 archives full final replay plus learner state; gain 3 archives only four fixed 2,048 replay samples. Whole training includes the respective export, imports/environment, collection/learning and metrics. Nested components overlap and must not be summed. Host collection/learning includes dispatch and waits, not GPU-only latency. Device/cache history, resets and trajectories differ; these clocks do not isolate learning kernels or faster successful learning.
